## 5. Primary algorithm for Model D (rule fixed in PLAN.md N9, decided on dev folds)

XGBoost D minus LR D on dev folds: +0.0008 [-0.0006, +0.0022]. Rule: XGBoost is primary only if the interval is entirely below 0. **Primary: D LR.** Rank-independent counterpart: D-norank LR.

## 6. Nonlinear effects and interactions (dev folds)

Depth-1 trees can bend each feature's effect but cannot combine features; deeper trees can. Comparing them isolates the two.

| question | diff | low | high | clearly better? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nonlinearity: best depth-1 XGBoost minus LR D | +0.0008 | -0.0006 | +0.0022 | no |
| Interactions: best depth-2 minus best depth-1 | -0.0001 | -0.0009 | +0.0006 | no |

## 7. Multicollinearity among Model D features (dev rows)

VIF = how much a feature is explained by the others (1 = not at all; above ~10 = heavily). High VIF makes individual LR coefficients unstable, not the predictions.

| feature | VIF |
|---|---|
| wr10 | 109.4 |
| dec_wr_60 | 101.9 |
| elo | 89.9 |
| adj10 | 70.7 |
| adj_dec_60 | 52.3 |
| wr90 | 46.1 |
| wr365 | 32.5 |
| adj90 | 32.4 |
| lrank | 30.5 |
| lpts | 26.7 |

Features with VIF > 10: 13 of 24. Pairs with |r| >= 0.8:

| feature 1 | feature 2 | r |
|---|---|---|
| rank_miss | pts_miss | 1.000 |
| lrank | lpts | -0.945 |
| wr90 | dec_wr_60 | 0.911 |
| elo | surf_elo | 0.889 |
| adj90 | adj_dec_60 | 0.881 |
| wr10 | dec_wr_60 | 0.864 |
| elo | wr365 | 0.861 |
| elo | lrank | -0.857 |
| wr365 | dec_wr_60 | 0.845 |
| adj10 | adj_dec_60 | 0.824 |
| wr10 | wr90 | 0.815 |
